capture.capture_viewport_note: the page was rendered at 1440 wide with the viewport HEIGHT raised (1000-2200) only so a tall panel fits in one frame; width, layout and type sizes are the real 1440 ones. Every frame parks the card ~130-145px below the top of the viewport.
capture.timezone: America/New_York (reproduces the 10:44-10:50 PM stamps of the 15 Sep frames)
capture.data: every row is built from this RO's own ro_change_events docs; no invented datum. The RO was reopened for the capture (POST /reopen -> parts_pricing) and closed again at the end.

events.note: line counts are unchanged from 15 Sep (13 / 21) — the two frames' rows are identical to ph-b-line1-open.jpg / ph-b-line2-open.jpg. No LINE row changed, so nothing in any frame moved.
